column1: A prototype LAM, the Ajax was a next generation Star League design. Following relatively successful initial trials, the Amaris Civil War rendered the design extinct; with production and testing ceasing due to the war. Designed to be easy to maintain, the Ajax uses pod mounted weapons similar to the modular weapons designed for the Mercury scout Mech. Able to switch modes faster than standard LAM designs, the Ajax has a less extensive transformation process; a benefit of the next generation technology used to create the Mech. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 原型陆空机甲（LAM）。Ajax 是星盟的下一代设计。初期试验相对成功，但阿玛里内战使这一设计绝迹；战争导致生产与测试停止。Ajax 以易于维护为设计目标，采用吊舱式武器，类似于为 Mercury 侦察机甲设计的模块化武器。它比标准 LAM 设计更快切换模式，变形流程也更简化，这是制造该机甲所用下一代技术带来的优势。 特性：陆空机甲 部署费用倍率：1.05

column1: This was an excellent Anubis light stealth chassis that has been absolutely ruined by pirates. The Stealth and advanced ECM systems are still intact, but the weapons are a mess. In place of the standard LRM-5s are a pair of 'ATM 3' launchers that function similar to MML systems and the arms have been fitted with makeshift flamers. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这具 Anubis 轻型隐身底盘原本非常优秀，却被海盗彻底糟蹋了。隐身系统和先进 ECM 系统仍然完好，但武器一团糟。标准的 LRM-5 被一对类似 MML 系统的“ATM 3”发射器取代，双臂还装上了临时拼凑的火焰喷射器。 特性：扩展躯干扭转 部署费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The Anzu was well-regarded by both MechWarriors and technicians for its reliability; the AMSC found the Anzu to be a good fit for the aggressive combat tactics they had developed since the Jihad. Although the Anzu's maximum ground speed was 64 kph, the Chilton 465 Jump Jets allowed the Anzu to jump up to 120 meters. The Anzu mounted eleven tons of Starshield A Standard Armor with CASE II built in to protect the 'Mech and its pilot from ammunition explosions. The Anzu also used the same life support systems as the Shadow Hawk, already well-proven by the time the Anzu entered service, and the RCA Instatrac Mark X targeting and tracking system allowed the Anzu to simultaneously engage multiple targets while also spotting for indirect fire through the installed TAG system. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Anzu 因可靠性而受到机甲战士和技术员的一致好评；AMSC 认为它非常适合自圣战以来发展出的激进战术。Anzu 的最大地面速度虽为 64 kph，但 Chilton 465 跳跃喷射器可让它跃过 120 米。Anzu 装有十一吨 Starshield A 标准装甲，并内置 CASE II，以保护机甲和驾驶员免受弹药爆炸伤害。它还采用与 Shadow Hawk 相同的生命维持系统；在 Anzu 服役时，这套系统已经久经验证。RCA Instatrac Mark X 瞄准与追踪系统则允许它同时交战多个目标，并通过安装的 TAG 系统为间接火力提供目标。 特性：多重追踪 部署费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The Argus is first and foremost a close combat 'Mech. For this reason, the Argus carries a Rotary Autocannon/5 and a pair of ER Medium Lasers for close combat. The Argus has a single Machine Gun to defend itself against infantry attacks, and an LRM-10 launcher provides the Argus with some long range striking capabilities. The Rotary Autocannon/5 and the ER Medium Lasers are linked to an advanced Targeting Computer which makes them extremely accurate. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Argus 首先是一具近距离战斗机甲。因此它携带一门旋转自动炮/5和两门增程中型激光，用于近战。Argus 还配备一挺机枪，防御步兵攻击；一具 LRM-10 发射器则赋予它一定的远程打击能力。旋转自动炮/5和增程中型激光连接至先进的瞄准计算机，使它们极其精准。 特性：灵活 部署费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

The Rotary Autocannon/5 and the ER Medium Lasers are linked to an advanced Targeting Computer which makes them extremely accurate.

column1: While the primitive Dervish 1S was decommissioned from military use throughout the Inner Sphere by 2990s, it experienced a resurgence in the Periphery in the civilian sector. The Dervish 1S-F is a makeshift design initially cobbled together from scrap heaps but later produced as a standard variant on low-tech worlds. Primarily designed to start controlled fires in remote areas, the loadout of the 1S heavily favors incendiary weapons. With a top speed of only 64 km/h the unit cannot out-run fires, so the cockpit is designed with additional heat shielding and environment controls. The limited jump range of 120 meters is sufficient to navigate ravines and other natural obstacles. Due to the civilian control several units have fallen into pirate or rebel hands and are used as makeshift terror platforms. Frequently used for extortion, the design has come to be known as the 'Bandit' through those areas where it remains common. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 原始的 Dervish 1S 在 2990 年代前已退出内天体军用序列，却在边缘区民用领域重新兴起。Dervish 1S-F 最初是用废料堆拼凑出的临时设计，后来在低技术世界作为标准变体生产。1S 的主要用途是在偏远地区控制火势，因此武器配置明显偏向燃烧武器。该单位最高速度只有 64 km/h，无法跑过火势，所以驾驶舱增加了隔热和环境控制。120 米的有限跳跃距离足以跨越峡谷等自然障碍。由于由民间控制，一些单位落入海盗或叛军手中，成为临时恐怖平台。它经常被用于勒索，在仍然常见的地区逐渐获得了“匪徒”的称号。 特性：超伸展驱动器 部署费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: What happens when an Industrial Mech Pilot turns into a Gladiator on the outskirts of the Periphery? With extra spikes, a Wrecking Ball and industrial Chainsaw it has everything to give someone a bad time. And lets not forget the Redneck Pilot's favorite, the Boomstick!
column2: 当工业机甲驾驶员在边缘区外围变成角斗士，会发生什么？加上额外尖刺、破坏球和工业链锯，它拥有让任何人都不好受的一切。别忘了乡巴佬驾驶员最爱的——大铁棍！

column1: An almost total refitting of a Banshee by a crazed ex-gladiator from Solaris VII resulted in the monostrosity known as the "Pyromaniac". The combination of a heat specific FCS and the armament of 4 Plasma Cannons, two Heavy Flamers, two Inferno-firing SRM-6 launchers and a head mounted flamer, all very heavily modified, shows why the 'Mech was given its name. Boosting a 375 ton XXL fusion engine makes the "Pyromaniac" more mobile than expected as well, combined with heavy armor making it a fearsome sight to spot on the battlefield. The downside of all this equipment is that both the center torso and the head has been utilized to fit the required ammo and no C.A.S.E system is installed. But this is just yet another sign how crazy the 'Mechs creator was. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19
column2: 一名来自太阳神七号的疯狂前角斗士几乎彻底重制了Banshee，造出了“纵火狂”。专用热管理火控系统配合4门等离子炮、两门重型火焰喷射器、两门地狱火SRM-6和头部火焰喷射器，解释了它的名字。375吨XXL融合引擎提升了机动性，厚重装甲使其在战场上极具威慑力；大量弹药占用了中央躯干和头部，且没有CASE系统，正体现出设计者的疯狂。 特性： Battle Fists 部署费用倍率： 1.19

column1: Someone stole this Barghest from the Blakists, and it's taken a good beating since then, Boss. Almost every scrap of the internals have been replaced, and they've managed to stuff some weird-looking pulse lasers into the Legs. This Periphery "Shotgun" takes the cake, though. It has internal ammo, looks like someone tried to build an LBX out of duct tape. The entire Cockpit has been re-engineered, complete with a distille and one of those music boxes they have in some older bars. The distille is somehow routed through the Coolshot, it makes some kind of Schnapps. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: 有人从布莱克教徒手里偷走了这具 Barghest，老大，之后它又挨了不少揍。内部几乎每一块零件都被换过，他们还把几门古怪的脉冲激光塞进了腿里。不过这台边缘区“霰弹枪”才是重头戏：它装有内置弹药，看起来像有人用胶带把 LBX 拼了出来。整个驾驶舱都被重新设计，配有蒸馏器和老酒吧里的那种音乐盒。蒸馏器不知怎么接进了冷却喷剂，会制成某种杜松酒。 特性：改良冷却套 - 激光 部署费用倍率：1.1

column1: Uhh... Commander, this 'Mech is really something! It's purposebuilt to just clobber the living crap out of just about anything it gets anywhere close to. For Heaven's sake, it has a damned LOCUST that's been custom-welded to its arm to function as a club, along with a few other premium choice Pirate 'accoutrements'. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: 呃……指挥官，这台机甲真是不得了！它的用途就是把附近几乎任何东西都狠狠砸烂。看在老天的份上，它居然把一具定制焊在手臂上的 LOCUST 当作棍棒，还有几件海盗精选的“装饰品”。 特性：近战驱动器 部署费用倍率：1.18

column1: The Brigand is a BattleMech that is surrounded by a sea of controversy as it is the first 'Mech to be produced by a pirate band. Manufactured by a company named Vengeance Incorporated, which is run by the pirates of the Haven Star Cluster and 'Lady Death' Trevaline, the Brigand represents an unprecedented threat because in spite of the fact that it is built by pirates, it uses advanced construction techniques and weapons. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: Brigand 是一具争议缠身的战斗机甲，因为它是第一种由海盗团伙生产的机甲。它由 Vengeance Incorporated 制造，该公司由避风港星团的海盗和“死亡女士”特雷瓦琳经营。Brigand 构成了前所未有的威胁：尽管由海盗制造，却采用了先进的建造技术和武器。 特性：战斗拳套 部署费用倍率：0.98

column1: We call the Cataphract a "FrankenMech" because it's got a little bit of everything stitched together on it. This was somehow 'repaired' by a punch of pirates, theres spikes everywhere, even in the chassis. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 我们把 Cataphract 称为“弗兰肯机甲”，因为它身上缝合了各种各样的东西。这台机甲不知被一群海盗如何“修好”，底盘上到处都是尖刺，甚至连底盘内部也不例外。 特性：近战驱动器 部署费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: A Retro Tech upgrade to the aging Catapult design, remodelled to employ 2 MARS Rocket Artillery Systems, Partial Wings and a uncanny ability to redeploy its mighty but limited payload as required.
column2: 这是对老旧 Catapult 设计的一次复古科技升级：重新改造后可使用两套 MARS 火箭炮系统和部分机翼，并具备按照需要重新部署强大但有限的弹药载荷的异常能力。

column1: This was once a Clint mech, but now it has spikes all over and it's current weapons, that either fire or blow up in your face. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.8 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这原本是一具 Clint 机甲，但现在到处都是尖刺，当前武器要么开火，要么在你脸上爆炸。 特性：改进瞄准 - 中程 部署费用倍率：0.8 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: While Corsair is supposedly a generic Periphery term referring to heavy and assault class FrankenMechs cobbled together out of desperation as the Succession War era dragged on, with no specific weight or base chassis, the most successful of these are ninety-five ton brutes modeled in a generally similar style, usually marked with a COR designation. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
column2: Corsair 据说是边缘区对重型和突击级弗兰肯机甲的统称。这些机甲是在继承战争持续期间迫于绝境拼凑而成，没有固定重量或基础底盘；其中最成功的型号是九十五吨级的巨兽，外形大体相似，通常带有 COR 标记。 特性：坚固 部署费用倍率：1.15

column1: This started as a fairly normal Crosscut X5M, and then some crazy fool ripped out the nice light AC2 and put a hotwired PPC in it's place. The scary thing is that it can take the heat. Oh, and watch out for the downright terrifying missile pack they bolted on too. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.72 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 它起初是一具相当普通的 Crosscut X5M，后来某个疯子拆掉了可靠的轻型 AC2，换成了热插线 PPC。可怕的是它居然扛得住热量。还有，他们在上面焊了一组令人恐惧的导弹包，小心。 特性：易于驾驶 部署费用倍率：0.72 手臂驱动器限制：左下

column1: Boss, this is one of Defiance Industries' Fafnirs, but the heavy gauss rifles have been replaced with these idiotic "rotary hammers" and the engine seems to be a homebrew attempt to replicate SLDF tech. They managed to get their hands on a bona fide Capellan stealth suite, though.
column2: 老大，这是一具 Defiance Industries 的 Fafnir，但重型高斯步枪被换成了这些愚蠢的“旋转锤”，引擎似乎是自制的星盟技术仿制品。不过他们确实弄到了一套正宗的卡佩兰隐身套件。

column1: The Firestarter is a dangerous 'Mech for its tonnage, carefully timed attacks with its Flamers can shut down any 'Mech and leave it open to punishment from your other forces. The FS9-T is designed to operate without supply lines. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
column2: Firestarter 以自身吨位而言是危险的机甲；用火焰喷射器进行精确时机的攻击，可以让任何机甲停机，任由你的其他部队处置。FS9-T 的设计目标是在没有补给线的情况下作战。 特性：无处不在 部署费用倍率：1.02

column1: The second BattleMech model introduced by the Free Worlds League, the Hector entered service in 2471. This pirate rustbucket abomination must be about that old. Main armament are two pirate FootCannons, with a targeting computer for long range fire and countering the inherent instability of the thing. And there are spikes. And a PPC(?) - for close range defense, possibly? Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.88 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 自由世界联盟推出的第二种战斗机甲Hector于2471年服役。这台海盗废铁怪物大概同样古老，主武器是两门海盗脚炮，配有瞄准计算机用于远程射击并抵消机体固有的不稳定性；此外还装满尖刺和一门用于近距离防御的可疑PPC。 特性： 窄体/低轮廓 部署费用倍率： 0.88 手臂执行器限制： 左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower

column1: This periphery Hellspawn refit is missing all of its advanced electronics, but what's here is in pretty good shape. Ten and a half tons of ferro-fibrous armor over an endo-steel frame give it staying power, while leaving room for four medium lasers and this hotwired LRM launcher. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - Missile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这具边缘区 Hellspawn 改装机缺少全部先进电子设备，但留下的部件状态相当不错。十吨半铁素体装甲覆盖在内构钢骨架上，赋予它持久力，同时还能容纳四门中型激光和这具热插线 LRM 发射器。 特性：改良冷却套 - 导弹 部署费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: This periphery Hellspawn refit is missing all of its advanced electronics, but what's here is in pretty good shape. Ten and a half tons of ferro-fibrous armor over an endo-steel frame give it staying power, while leaving room for four medium lasers and this hotwired LRM launcher.

column1: At first glance, this mech seems just as a normal Highlander equipped with an MRM 40 missile system in its left torso, apart from the spikes and spray paintings such as 'Megas' with flames in the background of course. However, if someone takes a look into it's internals, you will see, that this MRM weapon system is literally melded into it's left torso and it's reload mechanism is sped up by some jury rigged stuff to shoot more missiles. Even the cockpit got changed to include 2 red buttons with words scratched above, such as 'more missiles' and 'all the missiles', which I believe probably controls the weapons firing modes. Quirk: Reinforced Legs Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 乍看之下，这台机甲似乎只是普通的 Highlander，在左侧躯干装了一套 MRM 40 导弹系统；当然，尖刺和背景喷着火焰的“Megas”涂鸦除外。但如果查看内部，就会发现这套 MRM 武器系统几乎熔进了左侧躯干，重装机构还用临时拼凑的设备加速，以发射更多导弹。驾驶舱甚至被改装，加入了两个红色按钮，上方刻着“更多导弹”和“所有导弹”等字样；我猜那大概是武器射击模式控制。 特性：强化腿部 部署费用倍率：1.22 手臂驱动器限制：右下

column1: The Hollander was introduced in 3054 specifically to carry a Gauss Rifle into combat and act as a sniper, a job it has performed admirably for years. This Hollander has been so badly maintained that its housing can't support a ballistic of any kind, and a huge missile launcher has been mounted in the torso instead. The arms carry surprisingly advanced X-Pulse lasers, and the heatsink kit has been "upgraded" in an attempt to cool it all. In the spirit of a normal Hollander, all this firepower is protected by only minimal armor. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: Hollander 于 3054 年推出，专门携带高斯步枪投入战斗并担任狙击手，多年来一直出色地完成这项任务。这具 Hollander 维护得太差，机体外壳已无法承受任何弹道武器，躯干反而装上了一具巨大的导弹发射器。双臂携带出人意料的先进 X-Pulse 激光，散热器套件也被“升级”以试图冷却这一切。秉承普通 Hollander 的风格，所有火力只由极少量装甲保护。 特性：战斗拳套 部署费用倍率：1.05

column1: This Pirate refit of a Hollander II trades the usual Gauss Rifle for some kind of rotary rifle abomination. To their credit, these pirates at least thought to put some advanced electronics and more than token armor on it.
column2: 这具海盗改装的 Hollander II 用某种旋转步枪怪物取代了通常的高斯步枪。值得肯定的是，这些海盗至少想到了安装先进电子设备和不止象征意义的装甲。

column1: This cobbled together Icarus II looks like it started life as an authentic -1S but have been repaired and overhauled so many times that it more resembles a -2S. The nutjobs responsible for this monstrosity fitted it with two Harpoon Cannons and a Jump Jet Supercharger. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 这具拼装的 Icarus II 看起来最初是货真价实的 -1S，但经过无数次维修和大修后，更像 -2S。负责制造这台怪物的疯子给它装上了两门鱼叉炮和一台跳跃喷射增压器。 特性：改进瞄准 - 近程 部署费用倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：左下

column1: For once Pirate Lingo makes sense on a Mech, the Bilge Rat is exactly like the archaic Rodent it gets its name from. Relying on a mixture of speed and EWAR does this Quad Mech try to skim under the Radar and hide in the murky depths of a Chaotic Battlefield. Showing some bite when threatened the Mech packs several MRM 5's with paired Chem Lasers wired through the cockpit. Whoever designed the couplings made the machine a bumpy ride at best with the fumes leading straight into the Cockpit. I can only compare this to huffing a Marker while trying to run for your Life, unless the Engine explodes underneath you in true PiraSte Fashion. Someone carved 'Cheese and Sin' in the cockpit's interior as well. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06
column2: 这次海盗黑话在机甲上居然说得通：Bilge Rat 就像它名字所指的古老啮齿动物。凭借速度与电子战的混合能力，这台四足机甲试图从雷达下方掠过，藏进混乱战场的阴暗深处。受到威胁时它会反咬一口：数门 MRM 5 与成对化学激光通过驾驶舱接线。设计耦合器的人让这台机器的乘坐体验糟糕透顶，烟气直冲驾驶舱。我只能把它比作叼着标记器狂奔时吸气，除非引擎在脚下爆炸——那才是真正的海盗风格。驾驶舱内部还刻着“奶酪与罪恶”。 特性：受保护驱动器 部署费用倍率：1.06

column1: Well, it is a Longbow, for the most parts just a pretty normal looking one too, and if it werent for that engine and these weird Thunderbolt '30' id say they just stole it somewhere......
column2: 嗯，它是一具 Longbow，大部分地方看起来也相当普通；要不是那台引擎和这些奇怪的 Thunderbolt“30”，我会以为他们只是从哪里偷来的……

column1: Now would'ya look at this, this thing must have been kept alive and be loved for Hundreds of Years, It 'is' a Mackie, but they managed to cram Endo Steel and more modern tech into it, every piece shows signs of being repaired dozens if not hundreds of times. Theres also a '<3 Nature' sticker on the Engine! Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 看看这东西，它一定被人维护、疼爱了数百年。它‘确实’是一具 Mackie，但他们设法塞进了内构钢和更现代的技术，每个部件都显露出几十次甚至上百次维修的痕迹。引擎上还有一张“<3 自然”的贴纸！ 特性：易于维护 部署费用倍率：1.2 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: This pirate-rebuilt Mad Cat II is relatively coherent for pirate work. Paired missile launchers support ER PPCs at all ranges, though of course the weapons themselves are typical pirate nonsense. At least they had the good sense to put CASE in the torsos for when the ammo bins inevitably overheat and explode. Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这具海盗重建的 Mad Cat II 对海盗工程而言还算协调。成对的导弹发射器为增程 PPC 提供全距离支援，当然武器本身还是典型的海盗胡闹。至少他们有把 CASE 装进躯干的常识，以应对弹药箱最终过热爆炸的情况。 特性：可变射程瞄准 部署费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: Whatever pirates were responsible for this refit, they did a better job than most. This high-tech armor has been kept in good shape, and most of the equipment is totally functional. Just don't look too hard at that "HPCS" they've bolted in there. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 不管负责这次改装的是哪群海盗，他们的活儿比大多数人都好。这套高科技装甲保持得不错，大部分设备也完全可用。只是别太仔细看他们硬塞进去的那个“HPCS”。 特性：防空瞄准 部署费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: In 2778, having lost three quarters of his combined forces, General Aleksandr Kerenksy dug deep into past experiments. Needing to replace Aerotech and Mech units, he revived the Land Air project with self-contained weapon systems that could be carried into combat by these otherwise woefully under-armed units. Abandoned during Operation Exodus in 2784 and subsequently raided by Pirates in 3082, the Phoenix Hawk LAM has become a real threat during border raids. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: 2778 年，亚历山大·克伦斯基将军的联合部队损失了四分之三，他不得不深入研究过去的实验。为了补充航空和机甲部队，他重新启动了陆空项目，为这些原本武装严重不足的单位配备可携带投入战斗的自给式武器系统。凤凰鹰 LAM 在 2784 年的远征行动中被遗弃，随后于 3082 年遭海盗劫掠，如今已成为边境袭击中的真正威胁。 特性：陆空机甲 部署费用倍率：1.04

column1: Looted from a repelled Manei Domini assault on a Pirate Stronghold, this burned-out husk was rebuilt with liberated technology from a research outpost. The insides here are top-notch, but of course the weapons are typical pirate junk. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
column2: 这具烧毁的残骸来自一次被击退的 Manei Domini 对海盗要塞的进攻，后来用研究哨站缴获的技术重建。内部设备一流，但武器当然还是典型的海盗垃圾。 特性：改进通信 部署费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：右上

column1: This Revenant that the Blakists were using got somehow hijacked by Pirates. They turned it into a goddamn Security violation, it's basically nothing but an Oil Truck now. It has nothing to do with the original Revenant, they replaced everything with flamers and Oil. 4 Flamer nozzles, 2 in each torso and a fluid Gun in the Cockpit, this thing can Oil and Burn everything around itself. The Engine got a Pirate makeover and to no one's surprise the Distille in the Cockpit got rewired into there. This Thing was leaking on its way in here, I hope no one is going to light a Cigar next to the Mech, otherwise we are going to Explode. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
column2: 布莱克教徒使用的这具 Revenant 不知怎么被海盗劫持了。他们把它改成了彻底的安全违规品，基本只剩一辆油罐车。它与原版 Revenant 毫无关系，所有东西都被火焰喷射器和石油取代：4 个火焰喷嘴，每个躯干 2 个，驾驶舱还有一门流体枪，能把周围的一切都浇油并点燃。引擎被海盗重新改造，驾驶舱里的蒸馏器也不出意外地被重新接入其中。这东西一路漏油开进来，我希望没人在机甲旁点雪茄，否则我们都会爆炸。 特性：改进通信 部署费用倍率：0.99

column1: As Pirate refits go, this is mostly not too deranged. The AC/10 has been replaced with a mortar, and the machine guns are still there, if mangled. The small laser has been upgraded to a light PPC, and the SRM launcher has been "upgraded" as well. They've even given it a 'Mech-sized "shotgun" to carry. Just don't ask what's going on in the engine and cooling systems. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 按海盗改装的标准来看，这台机甲并没有太离谱。AC/10 被迫击炮取代，机枪还在，只是被弄得乱七八糟。小型激光升级成轻型 PPC，SRM 发射器也被“升级”了。他们甚至给它装了一把机甲尺寸的“霰弹枪”。别问引擎和冷却系统到底怎么回事。 特性：易于维护 部署费用倍率：1.09

column1: Based upon the good old Shadow Hawk 2H, the Valkyrja, 'Chooser of the Slain' in old Terran Norse, is specifically designed to support less than legitimate Active Shield and Vibro-Dagger. Additionally the Cockpit system is jury-rigged to support an 'ECM' that just sends Heavy Metal over all standard frequencies... Quirk: Industrial TSM Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
column2: Valkyrja 以老 Terran 北欧语中的“亡者之选”命名，基于老式 Shadow Hawk 2H，专门支援不太合法的主动护盾和振动匕首。驾驶舱系统还被临时改装，用来支持一种会在所有标准频率上播放重金属音乐的“ECM”。 特性：工业 TSM 部署费用倍率：1.07

column1: A rather unique ProtoMech that once belonged to a skilled Pirate leader, clad in and repaired with so much scrap and mismatched parts that it's impossible to tell what the base chassis ever was, or if it even had one. Fast and clearly designed with close combat in mind, this scrap bucket comes armed with a specialized Chainsaw and a unique, sawn-off twin-barreled pirate ProtoMech-sized shotgun. It's ramshackle nature makes it hard to gather exact specifications, but one thing's for sure; this thing will prove to be a real beast in close quarters. Quirk: Resilient Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 这是一台属于老练海盗首领的独特原型机甲，外覆大量废料和不匹配零件，经过反复修补后几乎无法辨认原始底盘，甚至无法确定它是否曾有统一设计。 特性： Resilient 部署费用倍率： 1.05

column1: This Blakist Jihad Stalking Spider has been made into a Work of Art to be honest. The Eight Improved Jump jets are still in, but rewired, redistributed and a little bit improved. Somewhere they found some Wings and bolted them on too. All of the 4 Legs in this Quad have been upgraded to the extreme. I'm talking about special Actuators, Talons and Jump Jets in each. Nearly all of the weaponry has been removed, except for a Single Laser that looks like it's going to fall off any second, with some bolted on Inferno Rockets. The Heatsinks and the Gyro have been both upgraded, The Engine was downsized and rewired to go into the Jump Jets to increase the Flight Time. The Cockpit has, too, been reworked and been given a Hotseat, Sensors for Increased Flight Calculations and a Gladiator FCS. I can Tell you one Thing, if this Thing starts flying, it will be one hell of a Bullet. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: 这台布莱克斯特圣战时期的Stalking Spider被改造成一件“艺术品”。八具改进型跳跃喷射器仍在，但线路和分配经过重做并有所增强；海盗还找到机翼并焊接其上。 特性： 稳定 Weapons 部署费用倍率： 1.1

column1: This was a Thunderbolt 5S until some pirates got their hands on it. All the weapons have been sort of welded into spikes, resulting in a loadout that's much closer ranged, and much hotter.
column2: 这原本是 Thunderbolt 5S，直到一些海盗拿到它。所有武器都被焊成了某种尖刺，结果射程更近、热量更高。

column1: Produced in 2546, the Toro was the Taurian Concordant’s first battlemech design. Based on captured Firebees, the Toro is a long range support mech. Armed with a PPC and a pair of LRM-5s the Toro carried two tons of ammo and 10 single heat sinks. The last Toro factory was demolished in 2598 by invading Star League troops and production would not resume until the Word of Blake Jihad. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: Toro 于 2546 年生产，是 Taurian Concordat 的第一种战斗机甲设计。它以缴获的 Firebee 为基础，是一种远程支援机甲。Toro 装备一门 PPC 和两具 LRM-5，携带两吨弹药和 10 个单散热器。最后一座 Toro 工厂于 2598 年被入侵的星盟部队摧毁，直到布莱克圣战时期才恢复生产。 特性：易于维护 部署费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左下

column1: This Republic Trebaruna has been turned into some slow walking Monster. The Hardened Armor is still on it, but they reinforced the Structure as well. Ripping out anything and everything that has to do with speed, don't expect this to move very far. The Armaments have been replaced with various Pirate and Periphery Weapons, some of which are either Genius Engineering or Insanity. They even crammed a Industrial TSM in there to mount all of these Weapons on the Mech. Looking at what this thing was supposed to do, I nearly think they made a Wannabie Urbanmech. Pirates, Boss, I tell you. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
column2: 这具共和国 Trebaruna 被改造成了缓慢行走的怪物。硬化装甲仍在，但他们还强化了结构。所有与速度有关的东西都被拆掉，所以别指望它能走多远。武器换成了各种海盗和边缘区武器，其中有些体现了天才工程，有些则纯属疯狂。他们甚至塞进一套工业 TSM，好把这些武器全装上。看看它原本的用途，我几乎觉得他们造出了一具自称 Urbanmech 的东西。海盗啊，老大，我真是服了。 特性：指挥机甲 部署费用倍率：1.17

column1: All of the offensive weaponry on this Ursa has been replaced or broken down. The Medium Pulse lasers have been 'piratified' and put into the Left and Right Torso, while the RAC2 was wholly replaced by a Pirate AC20 with Stabilized Housing, but i'm not even sure it's going to help that much. They put in some kind of TAG System in the Head but its taking up a lot of space. The MASC and XL engine have been ripped out to make space for some kind of Fuel intake for a Nitro Canister to increase its speed. Parts of the Armour have been lined with Spalling, to decrease Shrapnel that might come off of this thing for whatever Reason. There is also a Double Heatsink kit in there, to my surprise. This thing will blow itself up anyway as soon as that Nitro reaches the Core. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: Ursa 上所有进攻武器都被替换或拆解。中型脉冲激光被“海盗化”后装进左右躯干，RAC2 则完全换成带稳定炮架的海盗 AC20，但我甚至不确定这能帮上多少忙。他们在头部塞进某种 TAG 系统，占了大量空间。MASC 和 XL 引擎被拆除，腾出的地方用来安装 Nitro 罐的燃料进气系统以提高速度。部分装甲内衬了防剥落层，以减少不知为何可能飞出的碎片。里面居然还有双散热器套件，真让我惊讶。不过这东西迟早会在 Nitro 进入核心时把自己炸上天。 特性：稳定武器 部署费用倍率：1.09

column1: Some idiot got a hold of this poor ''Victor'', I'm not sure what all they did to his but somehow they strapped this monstrous thing on the right arm. They also scrawled ''The RACtor 9000'' in giant letters across the chest and drew a toothy grin over the cockpit glass. Yeah you heard me they painted over the duraplast. They also welded a damn flag pole onto the shoulder for flying a pirate flag. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - AC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
column2: 有个蠢货弄到了这具可怜的 Victor，我不知道他们究竟对它做了什么，但不知怎么把这个怪物绑在了右臂上。他们还在胸口用巨大字母写着“RACtor 9000”，并在驾驶舱玻璃上画了一个露齿笑脸。没错，他们把图案直接涂在透明装甲上了。为了飘海盗旗，他们甚至在肩部焊了一根旗杆。 特性：精准武器 - 自动炮 部署费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：右上

column1: Boss, this Xanthos apparently was in possession of a Pirate whaler, they put in Harpoons and some Targeting Device on the Mech to aim better. Just don't ask what it was made of in the start, i can't even tell the wiring apart, the Idiots took off the Colours of the wires. A MASC made its way into this too, for catching up when they 'Fly too fast.' Does he know there aren't any Whales in Space? Are we missing the bigger picture here Boss, or was this Pirate just on too many Drugs at once? Even the onboard information says he hunted 6 of them down, but no Pictures. Anyway,this Chassis really was ripped and refitted by Pirates to make it keelhaul something with those Harpoons as all other weapons have been taken out. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16

It fought all the way though Operation LIBERATION, suffering the highest losses of any artillery units. It is unknown if any were taken on Kerensky's Exodus, but each of the Successor States were able to take possession of many of the vehicles that were left behind; these went on to participate in the Succession Wars. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 100 20 Left 100 20 Right 100 20 Rear 60 20 Total 360 80 Quirk: Thermal Sight
column2: Vali生产超过五十年，是27至28世纪星盟国防军的主力。它参加了解放行动，炮兵单位损失最为惨重。没人知道克伦斯基大撤离时是否带走过它，但各继承国都接收了大量遗留车辆，并让它们继续参加继承战争。 生物群系限制：本单位因使用内燃机，无法部署于月球或火星生物群系。 移动： 4/6 格 / 120/180 米. 装甲： Ferro-Fibrous 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 100 20 左侧 100 20 右侧 100 20 后方 60 20 总计 360 80 特性： 热成像瞄具

column1: Named after the Vespa Genus of insects, the Vespa gunship is well equipped to sting it's opponents to death, one hit at a time. Hand made on the world of Redondo, the 15 ton Vespa has seen success across the Inner Sphere and Periphery. Produced by Vespa Inc since the 2843, the Gunship is exported at a rate of a couple of hundred a year to buyers everywhere. Powered by a 070 rated Fusion Core, the Vespa can reach speeds of 110kph and carries 3 tons of armour. A Large Laser is the Vespas only weapon. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 11/17 hexes / 330/510 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 70 10 Left 65 10 Right 65 10 Rear 50 10 Total 260 50 Quirk: Breaching Shot
column2: Vespa炮艇以昆虫属命名，擅长逐发刺杀敌人。15吨的Vespa手工制造于Redondo，在内层星域和边疆都取得成功；自2843年起由Vespa公司生产，每年向各地出口数百辆。070级融合核心让它达到110公里/时，装甲3吨，唯一武器是一门大型激光器。 生物群系限制：本单位无法部署于月球生物群系。 移动： 11/17 格 / 330/510 米. 装甲： 装甲 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 70 10 左侧 65 10 右侧 65 10 后方 50 10 总计 260 50 特性： 破甲射击

column1: It's had some unorthodox repair work done but it's a Zephyr for sure. The Sorenstein lasers have been replaced with over-tuned monstrosities that claim to have been made in Hell. The missile launcher refit is questionable. And someone scratched 'You're It' into the empty spot were the TAG should be. But amazingly the original ECM suite is still in place! Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 9/14 hexes / 270/420 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 180 20 Left 135 20 Right 135 20 Rear 100 20 Turret 160 20 Total 710 100 Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile
column2: 这台Zephyr显然经历过非正统维修，但肯定还是Zephyr。Sorenstein激光器被换成声称来自地狱的过调谐怪物，导弹发射器的改装也很可疑；有人还在TAG应在的位置刻下“轮到你了”。令人惊讶的是，原有ECM套件仍然完好。 生物群系限制：无。 移动： 9/14 格 / 270/420 米. 装甲： Ferro-Fibrous 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 180 20 左侧 135 20 右侧 135 20 后方 100 20 炮塔 160 20 总计 710 100 特性： 窄体/低轮廓

column1: In 3052 RISC Engineers took another look at their upgrade of the venerable Zhukov and decided it wasn't RISCy enough. Heavy RAC/5 replaced the reliable LBX/10. A Fuel Cell engine and Heavy Ferrofibrous armor allowed significant upgrades to the survivability and firepower of the reliable Zhukov. In 3030, Aldis Industries deployed the successful follow up to its venerable Demolisher design, the slightly lighter Zhukov. While it shares many of the parts and features of the design that inspired it, the Zhukov is smaller, better armored, and packs less weaponry than its predecessor. Its first major deployment was with the Wolf's Dragoons whereupon the Zhukov has since seen constant improvements and tweaks as suggested to Aldis Industries by the field units that use it. The Zhukov's strength is its relative simplicity. Two turret mounted SarLon MaxiCannon Autocannon/10s are more than adequate at providing sufficient firepower for the discriminating buyer while imitating its larger cousin the Demolisher. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. Armor: Heavy Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 300 40 Left 225 40 Right 225 40 Rear 185 40 Turret 250 40 Total 1185 200 Quirk: Main Battle Tank
column2: 3052年，RISC工程师重新审视老牌Zhukov的升级型，认为它还不够“RISC”。重型RAC/5取代可靠的LBX/10，燃料电池引擎和重型铁磁纤维装甲显著提高生存力与火力。3030年，Aldis Industries推出比Demolisher略轻的Zhukov；它更小、装甲更好、武器更少，却保持相对简单可靠。 生物群系限制：无。 移动： 3/5 格 / 90/150 米. 装甲： Heavy Ferro-Fibrous 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 300 40 左侧 225 40 右侧 225 40 后方 185 40 炮塔 250 40 总计 1185 200 特性： 主战坦克

column1: Well boss, the shell of this thing is still an Alacorn so you got a bunch of armor. But some junker thought the original Gauss Rifles were too heavy so they just cut the end of the barrels off, remounted them crooked in the turret and broke the optics in the process. Now what you have is a weapon that charges up a bit faster and fires a projectile in the general direction of your target.
column2: 老大，这东西的外壳仍是阿拉康，所以装甲不少。但某个拾荒者嫌原装高斯步枪太重，直接锯掉枪管末端，把它们歪歪扭扭地重新装进炮塔，还顺便弄坏了光学设备。现在这变成了一种充能更快、却只能朝目标大致方向发射的武器。

column1: This Strix has seen some special alterations by some pirate wise guy who actually added some pretty decent targeting system upgrades and thankfully was smart enough not to 'improve' the engine. The weapons though, well you might be better just flying the thing into you target.
column2: 这台 Strix 被某个海盗自作聪明地改装过：加装了相当不错的瞄准系统升级，好在他没去“改进”引擎。不过武器嘛……你还不如直接驾驶它撞向目标。

column1: The Bushranger is a Forestry and Surveyal 'Mech designed by the Star League to be deployed on planets still being 'tamed', the only design to receive unique reinforced structure and myomer more similar to Mech's far above its weight class is it not only sturdy, but able to carry large amounts of weight with ease. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - HandHeld Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11
column2: Bushranger是星盟设计的森林与测绘机甲，用于开发尚未驯服的行星。它采用独特强化结构和肌肉束，性能远超同吨位机甲，既坚固又能轻松承载大量重量。 特性： Accurate Weapon - HandHeld 部署费用倍率： 1.11

column1: First introduced by the Terran Hegemony in 2568, the Phoenix Hawk was one of the most well known BattleMechs in the Inner Sphere. This one, however, fell into the hands of some backwater planet MechTechs and has emerged an abomination. Armed with a cobbled-laser pistol and a filed-down vibrosword, this is one 'Mech you wouldn't want to run into on the dark streets of Hardcore. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01
column2: 凤凰鹰于2568年由泰拉霸权首次推出，是内层星域最著名的战斗机甲之一。但这台机甲落入偏远星球的机甲技师手中后，变成了可怕的怪物：装上一把拼装激光手枪和磨短的振动剑，成为你绝不想在黑暗街道遇到的机甲。 特性： 分散注意 部署费用倍率： 1.01

column1: This Chassis is weird boss, it definitely was a Star League Era Design, but it seems to have been rebuilt and repaired so many times that barely anything is left of it, dont even want to speculate how a bunch of Pirates got their hands on it. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 老大，这台底盘很古怪。它显然是星盟时代的设计，却被反复重建和修理，几乎没有多少原件留下；我甚至不想猜海盗究竟是怎么弄到它的。 特性： Anti-Air Targeting 部署费用倍率： 1.14 手臂执行器限制： 左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

column1: The Wolfman was first created by Valdis Ullman, a MechWarrior belonging to the Legion of Vega, on Bergman's Planet during the Second Battle of Ryersson in 2986. Originally piloting a Wolverine, his BattleMech was damaged in a fight with a Davion Marauder, with most of its upper body damaged or destroyed. Fortunately, a Davion Rifleman had been destroyed only a hundred meters away from his 'Mech. The Rifleman had suffered damage to its torso and legs. Ullman's personal technician, Sharis Brand thought that the two 'Mechs could be merged together, taking the intact legs and hips from Ullman's Wolverine and combining it with the torso and arms from the Rifleman. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Wolfman最初由维加军团的机师瓦尔迪斯·乌尔曼于2986年在莱尔森第二次战役中制造。他当时驾驶Wolverine与戴维昂Marauder交战，机甲上半身大部损毁。幸运的是，百米外一台戴维昂Rifleman也被击毁；乌尔曼的技师沙里斯·布兰德于是将Wolverine完整的腿和胯部与Rifleman的躯干和手臂拼接起来。 特性： Ubiquitous 部署费用倍率： 1.07 手臂执行器限制： 左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

column1: The "Creep" - named for the ability to deliver a deadly barrage as it creeps through the shadows under stealth. Built as a pet project by someone at RISC with too much money and a hate-boner for the Clans, this Blood Asp had a pile of advanced tech bolted to it and was turned inside-out in the image of the Inner Sphere. The "Creep" retains the Blood Asp's frontline assault role, albeit with a little more trickery. Keep the front toward the enemy and tape down that trigger block. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.23 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: “Creep”得名于它能在隐身状态下穿过阴影发动致命齐射。RISC某人因资金过多且憎恨氏族，把这台Blood Asp当作私人项目，给它装满先进技术并按内层星域风格彻底改造。它仍承担前线突击任务，但更加诡诈；让正面始终朝向敌人，并压住扳机锁。 特性： 坚固 部署费用倍率： 1.23 手臂执行器限制： 左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

column1: The Ebon Jaguar OmniMech was code-named "Cauldron-Born" by the Inner Sphere - a name taken from Irish legend to describe immortal, unstoppable undead. The unique armor fitted to this particular chassis certainly fits the bill, being described as "living" ferro-fibrous plating by members of the DCMS who encountered it. In actuality, the armor is closer to Hardened Armor impregnated with HarJel, but the average grunt cares not for the specifics. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Ebon Jaguar全能机甲在氏族入侵期间被内层星域代号称为“Cauldron-Born”，名称源自爱尔兰传说中的不死亡灵。该底盘使用的独特装甲确实名副其实，遇到它的龙马联盟军人称其为“活的”铁磁纤维板；实际上更接近掺入HarJel的硬化装甲，但普通士兵并不关心细节。 特性： 窄体/低轮廓 部署费用倍率： 1.16 手臂执行器限制： 左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

column1: Well, Boss. I've got good news and bad news. The good news is that the armor on this thing is top-of-the-line tech. The bad news is that I have no idea how badly I messed up getting it off. The armor, I mean. Why are you grinning?
column2: 老大，好消息和坏消息各一个。好消息是这东西的装甲属于顶尖技术；坏消息是我完全不知道自己拆装甲时把它弄坏到什么程度了。呃，我是说装甲。你为什么在笑？

column1: This Pirate version of the Hoplite includes multiple methods of interfering with another 'Mech's entire kit. It comes with a Taser, a Harpoon, and a pair of Fluid Guns that can spray a selection of chemicals on enemy units. It's equipped with a Mechanical Jump Jet system to get it in and out of range of its targets. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这台海盗版Hoplite拥有多种干扰敌方机甲系统的手段：装备泰瑟枪、鱼叉和两把流体枪，可向敌方喷洒多种化学物质；机械跳跃喷射系统使它能迅速进入或脱离射程。 特性： 分散注意 部署费用倍率： 1.03 手臂执行器限制： 左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

column1: The Kamakiri mounts three weapon systems mounted in the front of the VTOL - a single Tiegart Particle Projection Cannon and a pair of Telos ThunderShot Thunderbolt 10 Missile Launchers. The Kamakiri Attack VTOL was developed at the end of the thirty-first century by Yan Manufacturing of New Samarkand as a result of their growing success in the military aerospace market. Dubbed as resembling a praying mantis, the Kamakiri was an immediate success; the Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery personnel responsible for supervising the first vehicle trial watched for just two minutes before approving the Kamakiri for purchase. Moving as fast as many reconnaissance and strike platforms in service with the DCMS already thanks to the DAV 155 XL extra light engine, the original specification armor installed by Yan was replaced with seven tons of StarGuard Aurora Reflective at the request of the DCMS, who wanted to improve the Kamakari's protection against energy weapons, although the nature of the Reflective Armor didn't offer any additional protection against the flak commonly directed at VTOLs. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 7/11 hexes / 210/330 meters. Armor: Reflective Coating Structure: Structure Values A S Front 175 30 Left 140 30 Right 140 30 Rear 100 30 Total 580 150 Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Missiles
column2: Kamakiri 装有三套武器系统，是一台速度极快的轻型机甲，适合快速突袭和侦察。

column1: The Tokugawa Heavy Tank is a wheeled heavy tank designed in the Draconis Combine. The vehicle saw extensive use during Operation Bulldog in 3059, where it safeguarded Combine worlds from reprisals from the Clan Smoke Jaguars. It was also used in offensive actions against Jaguar units on Outer Volta, and later saw action during the FedCom Civil War, as well as during the Jihad era. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. Armor: Light Ferro Structure: Structure Values A S Front 275 30 Left 180 30 Right 180 30 Rear 145 30 Turret 245 30 Total 1025 150 Quirk: Main Battle Tank
column2: Tokugawa 重型坦克是龙马联盟设计的轮式重型坦克，曾在多场战事中承担装甲突击和火力支援任务。
